screen.mswsm.warning.title: Health & Safety Warning
screen.mswsm.warning.body: This modpack/server may contain flashing lights, rapid camera movement, visual effects, moving rides, or other content that may trigger motion sickness, dizziness, discomfort, or photosensitive seizures in some players.
screen.mswsm.warning.stop: Please stop playing immediately if you feel unwell.
